hero.eyebrow: Aadam · Forward deployed engineer · Accra GMT+0, overlaps EU + US East
hero.sub: I embed with operators, analysts and coaches, build the system they run their day on, and stay until the numbers move. Every screen on this kit is a system that shipped, with its real items and prices.
hero.hint: Tap stock, send it to the cashier, then collect to print.

c01.title: The counter
c01.note: Al Boyut sold over a counter, with prices in WhatsApp threads and stock that never matched the till. We built the register, a cashier queue that calls each order out loud, and one stock record behind both the shop and the website.
c01.hint: Tap stock, send it to the cashier, then collect to print.

c02.title: Every garment
c02.note: An-Nur's counter ran on paper slips. Now each drop-off is counted garment by garment, moves through washing, drying, ironing and a quality check, texts the customer when it is ready and closes with a scan.
c02.hint: Count garments in, confirm, then move the ticket along.

c03.title: Commerce that
c03.note: Fashion labels selling African print to two markets. Prices are set per market instead of converted, and the bag turns into a WhatsApp order, because that is where these customers already buy.
c03.m1: Markets, each priced on its own
c03.hint: Open a piece, add it to the bag, finish on WhatsApp.

c04.title: Models that
c04.note: The studio started on the investment side: four years in Ghanaian private equity and venture capital, taking 50+ SMEs from sourcing to Investment Committee. The models we build still show the downside first.
c04.m1: SMEs taken through the deal cycle
c04.hint: Hit the shocks. Watch the covenant light.

c05.title: Sell a dish,
c05.note: Delish ran on a POS and spreadsheets that never agreed. On Odoo 19, every dish deducts its recipe, supplier packs convert to pieces, and counts reconcile with workings an auditor can follow.
c05.hint: Open Inventory, sell a plate, then count the shelf.

c06.title: Shots and donors,
c06.note: A public court in Madina had been unusable for years. We co-led its renovation, raised the money from local donors, then built the platform that runs bookings, events and an open ledger of every cedi.

c07.title: Platforms people
c07.note: Exam pathways for West African students in three languages, verified rentals, an online pharmacy, and an export platform shipping cars to 40+ countries.
c07.hint: Pick a programme to see the subjects it needs.

buildDesk.title: Hire me, or
buildDesk.note: Flip the switch on the device. Build sizes a project in weeks, with no price tags. Hire sets up a role and checks our working-hours overlap. Both print a ticket with what you did on the kit and send it straight to me.

hero.sub: Aadam is a product, data and engineering studio in Accra. We build the point of sale, the ERP and the storefront, model the numbers, design the brand and put the business on the map.

practices.heading: What we do
practices.sub: Four practices under one roof. The team that models the numbers also builds the system and draws the brand, so nothing is lost in a handover.

analysis.title: Analysis and models
